product_overview: FitnessPro is a web application for gym members to book sessions, follow personalized training programs and track weight, and for coaches to manage programs, availability and member progress. It provides role-based dashboards, booking and scheduling, program creation, and visual progress tracking.
core_goals: Enable members to book coach-led training sessions and manage their personal fitness programs
Provide members with tools to track weight and program progress via charts and daily tasks
Provide coaches with tools to create and assign training programs and manage availability slots
Present role-based dashboards with actionable insights and easy navigation between booking, programs and tracking
Keep interactions simple and resilient with clear success and error handling flows

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users (members and coaches) using email and password; support test login buttons for quick access and redirect to role-appropriate dashboards.
user_flows: /login -> Fill email input field with member@gym.com -> Fill password input field with 123456789 -> Click Login button to submit -> Redirect to /dashboard
/login -> Click test login buttons to autofill credentials for coach@gym.com -> Click Login button to submit -> Redirect to /coach-dashboard
/login -> Fill email input field with invalid@example.com -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Member Dashboard
features.description: Give members a personalized overview of upcoming sessions, program progress, weight stats and daily tasks with quick navigation to booking and programs.
user_flows: /dashboard -> View upcoming sessions with countdown timer -> See next session countdown details -> View training program progress percentage -> Check recent weight entries -> Toggle daily task completion checkboxes -> Click quick action button to navigate to /booking
/dashboard -> View upcoming sessions with countdown timer -> Click quick action button to navigate to /programs -> View program overview with title and creation date
/dashboard -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See loading indicator -> See error message if sessions or programs fail to load

features.name: Book Training Sessions
features.description: Allow members to browse available time slots grouped by date, add optional notes and confirm bookings; reflect booked sessions in the upcoming sessions list.
user_flows: /booking -> View list of upcoming booked sessions -> Browse available time slots grouped by date -> Click Book Session button on an available slot -> Add optional notes for the session -> Confirm booking in dialog -> See success message after booking -> See booked session in list of upcoming booked sessions
/booking -> Browse available time slots grouped by date -> Click Book Session button on an available slot -> Confirm booking in dialog -> See success message after booking
/booking -> Browse available time slots grouped by date -> Click Book Session button on a slot that was simultaneously booked by another user -> See error message

features.name: View Training Programs
features.description: Members can view their personalized training program including daily tasks, weekly exercise plans and nutrition guidance, and toggle task completion.
user_flows: /programs -> View program overview with title and creation date -> Switch between tabs (Daily Tasks, Weekly Plan, Nutrition) -> Toggle daily task completion checkboxes -> View weekly exercise plan organized by day -> Review nutrition guidelines and recommendations
/programs -> Switch to Daily Tasks tab -> Toggle daily task completion checkboxes -> See updated program progress percentage
/programs -> Navigate to /programs -> See loading indicator -> See error message if program data fails to load

features.name: Weight Tracking
features.description: Track and visualize weight over time with a chart and table; add new entries via a date picker and input dialog.
user_flows: /weight-tracking -> View current weight and last update date -> See weight trend (gain/loss) from previous entry -> View total weight change since first entry -> Click FAB button to open add weight dialog -> Select date using date picker -> Enter weight value in kg -> Add optional notes -> Submit to add new weight entry -> See success message -> View updated line chart showing weight progression -> Browse table of all weight entries with dates and notes
/weight-tracking -> Click FAB button to open add weight dialog -> Select date using date picker -> Enter weight value in kg -> Submit to add new weight entry -> See success message

/weight-tracking -> Click FAB button to open add weight dialog -> Select date using date picker -> Enter invalid weight value (non-numeric or out-of-range) -> Submit to add new weight entry -> See validation error message

features.name: Coach Dashboard
features.description: Provide coaches with an overview of statistics, today's sessions, upcoming sessions and member progress with navigation to program and availability management.
user_flows: /coach-dashboard -> View statistics cards (active members, completed sessions this week, active programs, today's sessions) -> See today's sessions list with member names and times -> View upcoming sessions in a detailed table -> Review member progress table with session counts and weight changes -> Click quick action button to navigate to /program-management
/coach-dashboard -> View today's sessions list -> Click session row to view session details -> Navigate to /manage-availability to adjust slots
/coach-dashboard -> Navigate to /coach-dashboard -> See loading indicator -> See error message if statistics or sessions fail to load

features.name: Program Management
features.description: Allow coaches to create and edit training programs for members including title, guidance, nutrition items, weekly plans and daily tasks.
user_flows: /program-management -> View list of all existing programs -> Click FAB button to create new program -> Select member from dropdown list -> Enter program title -> Provide guidance text -> Add multiple nutrition items -> Configure weekly plan for each day with multiple exercises -> Add multiple daily tasks -> Save program -> See new program in list
/program-management -> View existing program -> Click edit button on existing program to modify -> Update guidance text -> Save program -> See updated program in list
/program-management -> Click FAB button to create new program -> Leave member selection or title empty -> Click Save program -> See validation error indicating required fields

features.name: Manage Availability
features.description: Enable coaches to create, edit and delete coach availability slots for members to book, and prevent deletion of already-booked slots.
user_flows: /manage-availability -> View all available slots grouped by date -> See booking status (Available or Booked) for each slot -> Click FAB button to add new slot -> Select date using date picker -> Select preset time from dropdown (08:00-18:00) or use time picker for custom time -> Save new slot -> See new slot listed as Available
/manage-availability -> View all available slots grouped by date -> Click edit button to modify existing slot -> Change time using time picker -> Save changes -> See updated slot details
/manage-availability -> View all available slots grouped by date -> Click delete button on an available (unbooked) slot -> Confirm deletion in dialog -> See slot removed from list
/manage-availability -> View a slot marked as Booked -> Click delete button on booked slot -> Confirm deletion in dialog -> See error if trying to delete booked slot
